Switches a fault on (`active` true) or off. `ROBOT_BLOCKED`, `ROBOT_BATTERY`
and `ROBOT_DISCONNECT` target a robot serial number; `ASRS_UNIT` (with
`aisle`) and `ASRS_NO_READ` (with `port`) target an AS/RS id. `value` is the
state of charge for `ROBOT_BATTERY`. `ASRS_NO_READ` applies only to an
OUTPUT port (only a RETRIEVE's arrival is read); naming an INPUT port is a
409 `WRONG_PORT_KIND`, an unknown port a 409 `UNKNOWN_PORT`.
